title: PCI-DSS: Network Segmentation — Payments VPC Subnet
description:
Create a dedicated VPC subnet for the Payments service, isolated from the general application layer. Required for PCI-DSS Level 1 compliance (NEX-217).

Design: Payments service will run in subnet 10.0.4.0/24 with strict security group rules. Only HTTPS ingress from the main application layer and egress to Stripe IPs allowed. No direct internet access.

Decision from architecture_review_01: Payments VPC design agreed upon. Arjun's microservice scaffold (PR #45) assumes this network topology.

Target: Complete by Nov 22 to align with pen test preparation.
